company.name: Forte
company.shortDescription: Forte is an economic technology for games that powers NFTs and rich token economies.
company.description: Forte is building economic technology for games that is secure, easy to use, and fully compliant. Its end-to-end blockchain platform enables the emergence of community economics, a system where the interests of game developers and players are aligned, leading to healthier, sustainable game communities. The team is composed of longtime industry members (Unity, ngmoco, Riot Games, Electronic Arts, Sony, and Rockstar Games, among others), and is currently working with over 25 acclaimed game developers from across the globe to reimagine the economics of games.

productsAndServices.description: A decentralized, zero-knowledge proof-based platform that enforces identity verification and compliance policies on blockchain without exposing personal data or taking custody of assets.
